learning_salience.rationale: Dominant coverage of high-importance KP kp_cs230_iteration_speed_as_a_core_ai_project_lever plus substantial coverage of kp_cs230_broad_literature_search_before_deep_implementation; concrete signals include the wake-word lamp framing, lightweight on-device detector tradeoff, broad paper/repo search, and expert outreach as first technical moves.

Dominant coverage of kp_cs230_collect_real_data_with_explicit_user_consent and substantial coverage of kp_cs230_synthetic_versus_real_data_trade_off; concrete signals include collecting real phrase-specific recordings with permission and contrasting them against synthetic voice diversity/distribution-mismatch risks.

Dominant coverage of kp_cs230_sliding_window_supervision_for_event_detection with substantial coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_class_imbalance_can_invalidate_naive_accuracy; section_flags mark demo_heavy=true and the 97% accuracy/zero-detection example is a clear diagnostic trap.

Substantial coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_diagnosing_overfitting_and_train_dev_mismatch plus dominant coverage of kp_cs230_additive_audio_augmentation_with_hard_negatives; concrete signals include train/dev gap diagnosis, waveform mixing with background noise, and hard negatives to avoid voice-activity collapse.

Dominant coverage of kp_cs230_debugging_cadence_should_match_training_time_constraints and substantial support for kp_cs230_iteration_speed_as_a_core_ai_project_lever; the section_flag importance is critical and the train-inspect-analyze-fix-relaunch cadence is directly assessable.

Dominant coverage of kp_cs230_pipeline_decomposition_for_ai_systems with section_flags demo_heavy=true; concrete signals include decomposing a deep-research assistant into query generation, search, fetch/page selection, and writing stages, then asking which component to optimize next.

Dominant coverage of gateway KP kp_cs230_manual_error_analysis_to_locate_system_bottlenecks; section_flags mark critical importance and demo_heavy=true, with concrete signals including inspecting intermediate outputs, spreadsheet failure-mode columns, and hotspot counts to avoid optimizing the wrong subsystem.
